description: Searches the workspace's error groups by text (type, message, route, file or extra data), status, project and release (including only the errors a release introduced). Returns each matching group with its status, type, message, route, top stack frame, event count, last-seen time and ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of errors to return

newInRelease.description: With release: only errors that first appeared in that release, to check what a deploy introduced

projectId.description: Filter by project id or slug (e.g. shop-api)

query.description: Text to find in the error type, message, route, stack frames or extra data, for example a route or a file name

release.description: Only errors with an event from this release (the release value the app passes to init, often a commit SHA)

name: runheed_search_errors
title: Search errors
